Per group: one of `server`, `cluster` or `local: true` (the default group may leave it out and use `options.deploy` / `--server` as before), `functions`, and optionally `port` (needed when two groups share a server) and `advertise` (the URL the other groups call, when the server's own address is not reachable).

Give its group an `advertise` URL: the address the other groups call when the server's own address is not reachable from them.

```yaml
gpu: {server: gpu-box, functions: [resize], advertise: http://198.51.100.7:8080}
```

The other side of it is the firewall: the address you advertise must accept connections on that port.
